//: This file exists for ONE reason: pinning the framework.
Without it, Vercel builds `middleware.ts` with its GENERIC Routing Middleware builder
instead of the Next.js one. That builder ships the middleware as raw transpiled source
plus an UNBUNDLED CommonJS `node_modules/next` tree — and `next/server` pulls in
`__dirname` is Node-only and does not exist in the edge isolate the middleware runs in, so
it throws `ReferenceError: __dirname is not defined` at module init — on every request, for
every route: MIDDLEWARE_INVOCATION_FAILED, whole site 500. The Next.js builder instead
emits one pre-bundled edge file where webpack has already folded `__dirname` down to '/'.
The dashboard's Framework Preset can be reset or carried over wrong from a previous
project (ours read 'No framework detected'). Declaring it here keeps the fix in the repo,
